theme: A travel day — south to St Pete
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar today, Dan — it's the road, the four girls in the back, and the Coffee Pot Bayou cottage waiting tomorrow afternoon. The holiday-booking items are the one thing worth catching while you've got miles to think.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Top-priority on the Mike + Dan board since Sep 14 — a full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week sells out; a refundable hold now removes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break plan
needsAttention.detail: The board set decide-by Sep 30 and book-by Oct 15 for all four kids over the holidays — that window's already past, and inventory for six only thins from here.

needsAttention.title: Cottage check-in at 4 PM
needsAttention.detail: Arriving the Coffee Pot Bayou place tomorrow with the girls — the host sent the door code and an arrival guide worth a look before you pull in.

flagged.title: Tampa Gardens statement is ready
flagged.detail: The senior-living office posted the monthly statement; payment is due by the 5th.

flagged.title: NACD New England run of show
flagged.detail: The agenda for the Oct 28 event went to the full group — worth a scan for anything that needs editing.

inbox.noise: Otherwise it's promotions and receipts — Airbnb, Apple, retail sales, and the usual newsletters.

recipe.title: Pumpkin chiffon pie
recipe.why: Deep autumn pulls toward squash and spice — a pie that leans on what's heavy on the market tables now.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + soap holder

acts.line: A clear calendar and the drive south — the quiet middle of the Maine-to-Florida run.
Miles and the four girls in the back, nothing owed to anyone but the road.
The kind of open evening a travel day earns — rest up for the last leg.
